key_insight: An AI interatomic potential enables cation-arrangement screening in (MoWNbTaV)S₂, revealing that vibrational entropy changes stability rankings and vibrational spectra provide fingerprints for identification.
engineering_relevance: The workflow supports finite-temperature screening and experimental characterisation of two-dimensional high-entropy materials beyond practical DFT sampling limits.
method: Train a Gaussian approximation potential on DFT data through iterative learning.
Calculate Gibbs free energies and run nanosecond molecular dynamics.
Analyse Raman and infrared spectra for configuration-sensitive signatures.
evidence_signal: Five selected configurations retained their trigonal-prismatic framework during nanosecond simulations up to 1300 K, while free-energy calculations showed entropy-driven changes in stability rankings.
watch_item: Simulated stability of selected configurations does not establish which cation arrangement forms during synthesis; experimental validation of the predicted fingerprints remains necessary.
paper_title: Prediction and characterisation of cation topology of pentanary high-entropy alloy (MoWNbTaV)S$_2$
